title: Seattle has never seen a star.
caption: The stars yelled "we're up here" and a Seattle cloud slid right over them mid-sentence. So they shoved the clouds apart. Pisces, Cancer and Scorpio: very Seattle. Send this to someone who hasn't seen a star since spring.
